build_PIDHead_for_PIDNet: build a PIDHead decode head for PIDNet with proportional, integral, and derivative branches for semantic segmentation
create_BasePIDHead_module: create a BasePIDHead module with convolution, normalization, and activation layers for feature processing
run_PIDHead_forward_training: run the PIDHead forward pass in training mode to get proportional, integral, and derivative segmentation logits
compute_loss_by_feat: compute segmentation loss by feature using proportional, integral, derivative logits and ground truth labels
init_PIDHead_weights: initialize PIDHead weights using Kaiming normal for conv layers and constant for batch norm layers
